_comment: P06-01 NORMALIZATION FIXTURES — provider-native input payloads + DECLARED mappings.
Authority: TRACKER Work Tracker!P06-01 (Entry Criteria 'Input fixtures available'; Evidence
The provider-native payloads below are the SAME synthetic local fixtures P05-01 uses
(p05/fixtures/feed-fixtures.json) — no new provider, no live source, no licensed data.
'localfix' is a SYNTHETIC LOCAL FIXTURE source and is NOT a provider-register issuance
beyond the single existing LOCAL_FIXTURE identity.
Mappings are DECLARED as data per P02_PROVIDER_MAPPING_RULES.md §5 (MD-1...MD-8), M-6 and
MR-4 ('reviewable without reading code'). Execution is P06 (MR-5).
The 'golden' block is GENERATED by p06/scripts/generate-p06-01-evidence.js and committed;
the golden tests assert byte-identity against it.

knownLimitations: Provider element 'sym' has no canonical counterpart and is DROPPED (M-4), recorded as a known limitation, never smuggled through.
LIVE-only price slots are pitEligible=false per P01_FIELD_DICTIONARY.md §3.
NL-4 / A-20: absent bid is SILENCE (NOT_PROVIDED), never zero and never an empty string.
NL-4 / A-20: absent ask is SILENCE (NOT_PROVIDED), never zero.
venueRef is a REFERENCE into D10; the provider venue code is never itself the canonical venue identity.
TS-4: a date-only session boundary is represented at an EXPLICIT UTC convention, DECLARED in MD-3 rather than assumed.
Provider element 'sym' has no canonical counterpart and is DROPPED (M-4).
Source silence about trade count is NOT_PROVIDED (M-5), never a fabricated zero.
COLLISION-CRITICAL (P01_FIELD_DICTIONARY.md §3, D4_07 §I.1): these slots correspond to existing free-form engine keys shared across 2-6 engines.
N-5 / FD-3: they are emitted ONLY namespaced as MD:valuation.* and may reach an engine ONLY through an explicit declared mapping owned by P11 — never by name coincidence.
UN-3: ratios are DIMENSIONLESS — no currency, no unit.

cases.note: Full two-sided quote. Provider element 'sym' is undeclared and must be DROPPED (M-4).
Source SILENCE about bid/ask/sizes: M-5 requires NOT_PROVIDED, never a fabricated zero.
Official close. 'trades' absent -> NOT_PROVIDED. 'sessionDate' is date-only -> TS-4 explicit UTC convention.
'trades' and 'vwap' absent -> both NOT_PROVIDED (M-5), completeness drops, quality becomes 'partial'.
COLLISION-CRITICAL valuation ratios. Emitted ONLY as MD:valuation.*; no bare engine key.

negativeCases.note: MR-2: an undeclared transformation is refused. No heuristic is applied.
FD-7 / OI-D9-01: a domain segment outside the accepted dictionary is refused, never invented.
Two entries declaring one canonical slot would be a C3 collision: refused at declaration time.
M-5: onAbsent may not fabricate a value for an absent source.
M-3: a provider-native element must not carry the namespace token.
A LIVE mapping is refused: live provider execution is NOT_AUTHORIZED (D9 N-1, D10 §8.2).
